bannerRule: Every ported banner names the new pin, as at the ffda3963 advance. The 386 ported files whose upstream path is byte-identical at ffda3963 and 04cb25f8 (checked file by file with `git diff --quiet ffda3963 04cb25f8 -- <path>`; 384 with a `path:` banner line plus the two `//` banners network/index.ts, identical, and network/comps.ts, still absent upstream) change only their banner line; the 12 that changed upstream are forward-ported below. G5.d requires the pin on every vendor banner.

client.app/cache/account/base.ts: TAKEN (04cb25f8). getMediaURI(components, entity, false): the pfp refresh no longer warns on an account without a MediaURI. Log-only; no formula. The lens never passes the `pfp` option, so the line is unreached here.

contracts/libraries.LibAccount.sol: Adds getByOwnerOrOperator: the account whose id is uint256(uint160(addr)) if it is an ACCOUNT, else the account the CacheOperator component maps addr to; reverts 'Account: no account detected'. Now the caller rule of AuctionBuy, ItemTransfer, KamiGachaMint and the four Trade systems (04cb25f8). No formula. The lens's account-key rule (1.1.0, §3.19) follows the same order.
contracts/libraries.LibKill.sol: sendSalvage takes the item index: the victim's salvage is paid in the node's yield item (HarvestLiquidateSystem passes LibNode.getItem), no longer always MUSU (1828dbff). calcSalvage / calcSpoils / calcRecoil arithmetic unchanged. Served: the node liquidation preview's `salvage` is an amount of the node's yield item from this contract version on; 1.1.0's `yieldItem` names that item. (The reference client's battle log dates the production upgrade at block 34,199,935.)

classification-affecting.player-string write systems: ChatSystem, AccountRegisterSystem, AccountSetNameSystem, AccountSetBioSystem, KamiNameSystem, KamiOnyxRenameSystem: unchanged.
classification-affecting.clients/kamiden/proto.ts: Unchanged. docs/string-classification.json is re-pinned to 04cb25f8 and gains only the 1.1.0 node fields (hand-reviewed with the change set).

state-affecting.componentIDs.json / deploy.json: Unchanged. No component added or removed.
state-affecting.systems: AuctionBuy, ItemTransfer, KamiGachaMint and TradeCancel/Complete/Create/Execute resolve the caller with LibAccount.getByOwnerOrOperator (owner or operator may act); ItemTransfer also requires the target to be an account. KamiSend, KamiGachaReroll and KamiSacrificeCommit now call LibSoulbound.verify (beside KamiMarketList, KamiMarketAcceptOffer and Kami721Unstake, which already did). GoalClaim/GoalContribute check the disabled flag on the goal id (2b4dc4cc). HarvestLiquidate passes the node's item to sendSalvage. _PoolRegistrySystem: comment only. The soulbind expiry is a ValueComponent value at keccak256(abi.encode(kamiID, 'SOULBOUND')) — already in the mirror; 1.1.0 serves it as `soulboundUntil`.

sync-affecting.network/setup/setupMUDNetwork.ts: Not ported (browser network setup, swap point 1).

coverage-affecting.modals/map (Grid, GridFilter, GridToolti: New map views: per node the level cap (the node's LEVEL / CURR_MAX requirement) and the yield item — SERVED from 1.1.0 by `node` (`levelCap`, `requirements`, `yieldItem`); an activity view (kamis per node and operators per room over 30 days) — the occupancy half is `node`/`room`, the 30-day activity grading is a display aggregate, not served.
coverage-affecting.modals/kamiSend, modals/gacha/display/re: Soulbound kamis are filtered out of send, reroll and sacrifice pickers — the fact is SERVED from 1.1.0 as `soulboundUntil` on `kami` and `party` rows. Kamiswap listings gain a minimum-level filter (4f5c74c2) over listing data the lens already serves (`market`); a client-side filter, no new chain fact.
coverage-affecting.modals/kami/battles/EventColumn: The battle log names the salvage item (the node's item after block 34,199,935, MUSU before). The lens's `battles`/`feed` rows serve salvage as an amount without naming an item; recorded, not changed in 1.1.0.
coverage-affecting.modals/goals: A paused co-op shows '(paused)'; goals are not served (docs/coverage.md 'goal' row) — the forward-ported Goals shape carries `disabled`.
coverage-affecting.other modal/fixture/library edits (quest: Presentation or flow changes; no chain-derived fact a player sees that the lens does not already serve or list as a coverage row.

newlyPorted: network/shapes/Kami/soulbound.ts (new upstream at 04cb25f8). One lens change: isSoulbound's Date.now() → clock.now() (§3.8) — the pin-advance tripwire in test/clock.test.ts refuses a naive wall-clock read in the projection trees. getSoulboundEnd, the function the lens serves through, is verbatim.
licence: 38085c24 adds LICENSE (AGPL-3.0-only) and NOTICE.md: code AGPL-3.0-only (unchanged for the ported files, which this repository already distributes under AGPL-3.0-only with their changes marked); game content — art, sound, writing including the names and descriptions of kami, items, NPCs, rooms, quests and skills, and the world data — is reserved, with a community-use grant that names 'tools about Kamigotchi'.
